lastCompletedStory.title: Thread the selected issue id into the planner task prompt (runner authoritative)

nextStoryContext: US-001 adds buildPlannerTaskPrompt(issueId) as an exported helper in src/supervisor/plan-runner.ts. The planner task prompt is now built AFTER issue selection (post-null-check), from issue.id. US-002 (subagent-planner honors explicit target issue id) must update both templates/agents/subagent-planner.md and .claude/agents/subagent-planner.md to read the target from the prompt and obey it. The E2E chain is: sidecar picks CAM-157 -> buildPlannerTaskPrompt('CAM-157') -> prompt reaches planner agent -> planner reads 'Plan issue CAM-157 specifically' -> sets prd.json.issueNumber=157. The runner side is done (US-001); the agent-prompt side (US-002) is next.
